en.title: Saemangeum New-Energy Industry Atlas
en.summary: Today verified that the Saemangeum trunk water-pipeline implementation plan was approved and announced on 4 September, with the official release published on 7 September. The Okgu and Gyehwa systems are planned to start construction in October 2026 and finish in 2028, serving areas including the Smart Waterfront City and Saemangeum New Port. This is enabling water infrastructure, not energy commissioning.

en.next: Next output: check October tender/contract/start notices plus route, diameter, budget, contractor, and permits; continue tracing the four KAIA comparators to formal calls, selections, and execution locations.
en.unfinished: No contract, contractor, actual start, acceptance, or completion evidence exists yet; no new energy FID, grid-connection, or commissioning record was found in the checked sources.

en.next: Next output: lock the version and have a real competent independent reviewer complete all twelve cases with confidence, misses, false positives, and dissent.
en.unfinished: No human reviewer has evaluated the packet. The additions extend the protocol but do not validate its thresholds.
